posted_materials.submission_timeframe_notes: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, OH will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a OH hospital facility."
posted_materials.inconsistency_notes: FPL in application is 2025, FPL in summary is 2024.
posted_materials.languages_available: English, Spanish, Chinese, Russian, Italian, Korean, French/Haitian Creole

review_notes.other_notes: PSA: "Everyone in New York State who needs emergency services, non-emergency or medically necessary services at Oneida Health are eligible for a discount if they meet the income levels."
